title.narrative: Voluntary medical program for pediatric cardiac catheterization

description.narrative: - Catheterization was performed for 38 patients - 47 therapeutic catheterizations of the coronary arteries - A mitral valve insufflation was performed - 1 pulmonary valve insufflation case was performed for a 16-year-old girl - 3 intra-arterial ultrasounds were performed - 47 stents were performed - An ultrasound was performed For 6 cases - 9 doctors were trained in different regions of Kenya - Training via catheterization simulator for all staff

Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment. 2. Performing 50 advanced therapeutic catheters. 3. Providing patients with medication needs as needed. 4. Training of 6 Kenyan medical staff in the field of advanced therapeutic catheterization.
The heart catheterization program is part of a series of voluntary medical programs at the King Salman Center for Relief and Humanitarian Work.
